# Handwriting lookup data

`assets/draw-model.js` packages the **mmah.json** character descriptors from [HanziLookupJS](https://github.com/gugray/HanziLookupJS), derived from [Make Me a Hanzi](https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi) and the Arphic PL KaitiM GB / Arphic PL UKai fonts. The descriptors cover 9,507 simplified/traditional character forms. Their upstream README explicitly permits separate redistribution and modification under the **Arphic Public License**; the full license is retained in `LICENSE-APL.txt` in this directory.

Only that APL data is included. The GPL HanziLookupJS engine and its GPL `orig.json` model are not bundled. `draw-recognizer.js` is an original geometric matcher using normalized direction, segment length, position, stroke count, and sequence distance. It provides approximate candidates, not a handwriting correctness grade or confidence percentage. A candidate may have no entry in this app's smaller dictionary.

The source JSON arrays and Base64 descriptors are unchanged in the JavaScript package. Content-addressed copies are generated by `scripts/build-preview.py`. Production pages load the recognizer and data only when drawing search is requested, from the same origin; drawings are not uploaded. The standalone HTML embeds those exact assets for portable use.
